findings.evidence: `hdeg` is used only at lines 146–150 to construct `hspan`; the remainder of the proof consumes `hspan`.
findings.fix: Prove the core theorem from a spanning hypothesis, then retain the exact-degree statement as a corollary using `Polynomial.Sequence.span`.
findings.issue: `bareNormalizedLp_ortho_eq_bot` assumes exact degrees, but its completeness argument only needs `Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range p) = ⊤`; exact degree is merely one sufficient way to obtain that fact.

findings.evidence: Lines 79–97 prove polynomial evaluations are `MemLp` from `hexp`; the Hermite caller repeats exactly the constant-multiplication derivation at `Function/HilbertBasis.lean:115–127`.
findings.fix: Construct the normalized `MemLp` proof internally (or provide a general normalized-polynomial helper) instead of requiring every caller to repeat it.
findings.issue: The `hmem` hypothesis is redundant: `hexp` and `memLp_two_algebraMap_eval` already imply each normalized polynomial is in `L²`, since division by `√(c n)` is constant multiplication and `hc` makes it nonzero.

summary: The completeness criterion exposes two stronger-than-necessary hypotheses instead of stating the natural spanning result and deriving its normalized exact-degree specialization.
